name: AI Security Command Center: Audit Log Check
description: Runs `ascc audit verify` on the hash-chained log the Claude Code hook writes every decision to, and fails the run when a line was edited, removed or reordered, naming the first one. Reads the log, writes nothing. It checks the chain, not the head: a log cut short, or emptied, still passes, and only a missing file fails. The head moves with every hook decision, and a scheduled run has nowhere safe to keep it. Makes no network call. Needs the ascc binary, built with Go 1.26 or newer, and a folder set up as the README's quick start shows.

parameters.label: ascc binary
parameters.help: The ascc binary (`go install github.com/ai-automation-tools/ai-security-command-center/src/cmd/ascc@latest`). `ascc` works when Go's bin folder is on the scheduler's PATH; otherwise give its full path.

parameters.label: ascc folder
parameters.help: The folder you run ascc in: it holds ascc.registry.json, policies/ and .ascc/audit.jsonl.

author: ai-automation-tools
